event_records.description: Dr. Tanaka submits the survey protocol to the Ashvale University research ethics board for review.

dr_tanaka.name: Dr. Tanaka
dr_tanaka.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Tanaka.
Dr. Tanaka has prepared a survey protocol for a research study. They intend to submit it to the Ashvale University research ethics board for approval. They are aware of the upcoming monthly meeting and hope for approval.

ashvale_university_research_ethics_board.name: Ashvale University Research Ethics Board
ashvale_university_research_ethics_board.persona_brief:
You are Ashvale University Research Ethics Board.
The board is a committee that reviews research protocols. It meets monthly. It has received or will receive Dr. Tanaka's survey protocol. The board will consider the protocol at its next monthly meeting, which occurs before the hard cutoff.

resolution.question: Will Ashvale University's research ethics board approve, request amendments to, or reject Dr. Tanaka's survey protocol at or before its next monthly meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the board has communicated a decision (approve, request amendments, or reject) regarding Dr. Tanaka's protocol before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
